acc.emailSecurityHint: Changing your email requires your current password and verification of the new address. You will need to sign in again.
acc.emailCodeHint: A code was sent to {{email}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
acc.deleteWarning: Your account will be disabled for 30 days. You can restore it using a code emailed to you. After that, deletion is permanent.
acc.deleteMessages: Delete my messages and chats after 30 days
acc.deleteCodeHint: Enter the six-digit code sent to {{email}} to confirm deletion.
acc.requestError: Could not process the request. Check your connection and try again.

chats.typingHint: Don't send your typing status from this device. You can still see other people's typing status.
chats.enterToSendHint: New line: {{shortcut}}. This preference only affects this device.
chats.ctrlEnter: Enter; send with Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter
chats.welcomeHint: Your welcome message is displayed in an empty private chat before the conversation starts. It is not sent automatically and does not trigger notifications.
chats.welcomePlaceholder: Write what people will see before starting a conversation…
chats.welcomeRequired: Enter some text to enable the welcome message
chats.welcomeInfoDescription: This text was set by the person in their chat settings. It appears only before a private conversation starts. It is not a sent message, creates no notifications or read receipts, and disappears after the first real message.

general.quickActionsDesc: Up to three page shortcuts in the header context menu
general.quickActionsChat: Chat with a contact or group
general.trafficHint: When auto-loading is off, attachments load on tap. The cache stores built-in wallpapers only, never chats or private photos.

habits.archivedInSideMenuHint: Show archived activities in the side menu
habits.archivedInProfileHint: Show archived activities along with active ones to other users in my profile (if activities are hidden, archived ones will also not be displayed)

notifications.planRemindersHint: Off by default. Enable Web Push to receive notifications. Configure extra reminders on each plan.
notifications.planRemindersNoTime: Plans without a time use 9:00 AM in the plan's time zone.
notifications.remindersDescription: Activity reminders, only when you choose to receive them.
notifications.reminderGeneralHint: Allow selected reminders about your activities
notifications.commonReminderHint: An extra reminder for all activities
notifications.remindersRuleHint: Choose events and times. Changes save automatically.
notifications.remindersInactiveHint: Enable reminders above to change rules.
notifications.remindersNoActivities: You have no ongoing activities yet.
notifications.browserDisabled: Browser notifications are off. Allow them to receive messages and selected events.
notifications.browserUnsupported: System notifications aren't supported by this browser.
notifications.permissionHelp: Allow notifications for AT in browser settings, then return here.
notifications.noAdvertising: We don't send ads or unnecessary notifications. Only your selected AchieveTogether events and messages.
notifications.browserOnly: Web Push can deliver messages and chosen notifications even after the site is closed.
notifications.pushActive: Push is active on this device. Messages can arrive even when the site is closed.
notifications.pushInactive: Browser permission is granted, but push is not yet enabled on this device.
notifications.pushUnavailable: Web Push is not yet configured on the server. Subscription will be available once VAPID is configured.
notifications.pushRequiresPwa: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work only from AT added to your Home Screen.
notifications.pushError: Could not connect push notifications. Check your connection and browser settings.
notifications.pushDisabled: Push notifications disabled on this device
notifications.iosAdd: How to add AT to Home Screen
notifications.iosHelpDescription: Web Push requires iOS/iPadOS 16.4 or later. Add AT to Home Screen and launch it from its app icon.
notifications.iosStep1: Open AchieveTogether in Safari and tap Share.
notifications.iosStep2: Choose Add to Home Screen → Add, then launch AT from the new icon.
notifications.iosStep3: Open AT Settings → Notifications and tap Allow notifications.
notifications.pushToggleHint: Get new messages even when the app is closed. Enable on each device separately.
notifications.pushNotSupported: This device or browser does not support background Push. Notifications inside the open AT app still work.
notifications.remindersPushHint: Enable browser push notifications on this device to receive reminders.
notifications.reminderEditorIntro: Select an activity and set its reminder times. You can enable multiple events.
notifications.reminderPickActivity: Select an activity to set reminder times
notifications.reminderNeedsStart: This reminder requires a start time on the activity.
notifications.reminderNeedsEnd: This reminder requires an end time on the activity.
notifications.reminderAutoSaved: Changes save after you select or update a time.

personalization.sideMenuMobileHint: On phones, open the side menu with the header button or a swipe. It fills the screen, so pinning is only available on desktop. Your desktop preference is saved locally in that browser.

privacy.whoSeesPhone: Who can see your phone number

exceptions.activityWho: Who can invite me to activities
exceptions.hint: Exceptions reverse the general rule and change with it. Blocked users can never invite you.
exceptions.noContacts: No contacts. Search for a user above.

invites.title: Group invitations
invites.hint: Contacts are people you have messaged in a private chat. Message invitations require your confirmation. Blocking prevents invitations in every mode.
invites.summary: Added: {{added}}. Invited by message: {{invited}}. Not allowed: {{blocked}}. Already processed: {{already}}.

privacy.cookiesHint: Essential sign-in cookies and an optional quick sign-in cookie. You can change your choice at any time.

security.sentHint: Email sent to {{email}}. Link expires in 15 minutes.
security.confirmHint: A confirmation email will be sent to: {{email}}
security.logoutAll: Log out from all devices except this one
security.passwordHint: Change your account password. You'll need to sign in again.
security.devicesHint: View authorized devices, revoke individual sessions, or sign out elsewhere.
security.regenerateWarning: Previous backup codes stop working when new ones are generated.
security.emailLinkHint: Open the link in your email to confirm. The link expires in 15 minutes.
security.confirmAction: Confirm this action. All devices will require you to sign in again after changing security settings.
security.confirmEnabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled. Save these backup codes: they will not be shown again.
security.confirmDisabled: Two-factor authentication is off. Sign in again.
security.backupNotice: Each backup code can be used only once to sign in instead of your email code. Store them outside AchieveTogether.
security.backupError: Invalid or already used backup code

language.description: Choose your interface language. Changes apply immediately.

securityDevices.description: Manage signed-in sessions and quick sign-in devices. Device names are estimated from browser information.
securityDevices.confirmSession: This device session will end and will require a new sign-in.
securityDevices.confirmTrust: Quick sign-in on this device will be disabled.
securityDevices.confirmOthers: All other sessions and quick sign-in devices will be revoked.
securityDevices.legacy: This sign-in predates device tracking. Sign in again to make it appear in your sessions.

backgroundLibrary.title: Background
backgroundLibrary.helpIntro: Icons next to the wallpaper name indicate available features and settings.
backgroundLibrary.helpMotion: This wallpaper can move. Turn motion on and adjust the speed in appearance settings.
backgroundLibrary.helpTheme: This wallpaper uses your accent and gradient colors. Photographs and solid color do not depend on them.
backgroundLibrary.helpAppearance: AchieveTogether illustrations reflect the app's appearance settings.
backgroundLibrary.helpPattern: You can adjust the arrangement, size and visibility of drawings in the wallpaper settings.
backgroundLibrary.helpFill: Choose a solid or gradient fill and customize its colors.
backgroundLibrary.helpGlow: Turn on the logo glow and adjust its intensity.
backgroundLibrary.limit: You can store at most five backgrounds
backgroundLibrary.deleteHint: The image will be removed from your library.
backgroundLibrary.holdToPreview: Hold a thumbnail for 350 ms to preview without applying. Swipe the collapsed strip to browse.
backgroundLibrary.patternAvailable: Pattern arrangement and size can be customized
backgroundLibrary.uploadHint: Move and zoom the image to frame it. JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF up to 25 MB are accepted. The output is saved as WebP.
backgroundLibrary.uploadGifHint: Cropping a GIF keeps only its first frame.
backgroundLibrary.uploadInvalid: Unable to open image: unsupported format or file larger than 25 MB.

pending.title: Account pending deletion
pending.description: Restore your account before the deadline. While it is pending deletion, you cannot use the account and others cannot message it.
pending.sent: A recovery code was sent to {{email}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
pending.missing: Sign in to check your account's deletion status.
pending.pendingOther: This account is pending deletion. Messaging is unavailable.
